subject: Reference format (control characters in a free-form line)
notes: kb/Work PB1496 + PB1800. cite.py --check 6.1 'The implementor shall specify any control characters that terminate a free-form line' OK 6.1 b). ONE set, ONE stage: PhysicalLines ends a line at LF (a CR immediately before it belongs to the terminator), and the lexer's line end is the LF only (COMMENT_TEXT / COMMENT_END / STR_BODY / WS no longer name CR or TAB), so a lone CR is a character of a comment or a literal and a >> after it is not at a line start. Probed: a *> comment holding a lone CR does not end at it (HIDDEN not displayed), and a literal's lone CR is F(2:1) = X"0D".
